fieldNotes.location: COULD NOT POSITIVELY LOCATE. Roster lat/lng (37.971559, -87.57109) point to downtown Evansville's civic/office core — not an industrial site; clearly wrong for a DSD depot. The only consistently-cited address across business directories (Cortera, Indeed) is '2600 S Kentucky Ave, Evansville, IN 47714-4513' for 'Keurig Dr Pepper Inc'. That address geocodes (Nominatim) to 37.9440, -87.5481; satellite imagery there shows a large empty parking lot and a generic white-roof industrial building with NO beverage-distribution signage, NO visible loading docks with trailers, and NO recognizable truck yard. Street View (2019/2023) of S Kentucky Ave shows generic light-industrial buildings and a green-fenced vehicle/equipment lot. The address is most likely an administrative/registered address rather than an active beverage-distribution warehouse, or the depot has minimal footprint / has relocated. Note: historically the Dr Pepper / RC distribution in Evansville was tied to Royal Crown Bottling Corp (1100 Independence Ave), which was renamed 'Vision Beverage' in 2020 and stopped distributing KDP brands.
fieldNotes.coords: Best-effort placeholder centered on the white-roof building near 2600 S Kentucky Ave; NOT a confirmed KDP facility.

fieldNotes.recommendation: Flag for human review.
